scripts.sidecar:build: dotnet publish ../API -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o ../API/publish && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp ../API/publish/API src-tauri/binaries/api-server-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && chmod +x src-tauri/binaries/api-server-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.sidecar:build:win: dotnet publish ../API -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o ../API/publish-win && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp ../API/publish-win/API.exe src-tauri/binaries/api-server-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
scripts.tauri:full-build: npm run sidecar:build && tauri build && bash scripts/patch-deb.sh
